decoder_protocol.evaluation: fit only on split=fit states; evaluate only on split=held_out states; never fit on held-out labels or states
decoder_protocol.fit_transform_pairs: cartesian product of fit_delays with fit_delays
decoder_protocol.held_out_transform_pairs: all delay pairs not in fit_transform_pairs
decoder_protocol.scope: one fixed decoder per task across preserve and transform fixtures
decoder_protocol.state_snapshot: persistent state immediately before the task query transition

quantization.arithmetic: float32 transition arithmetic in q8-state mode
quantization.clipping: clip real state to [-1,1] before scaling and integer state to [-127,127] after rounding
quantization.execution: quantize persistent state after every recurrent step and before every subsequent step, serialization, and query readout
quantization.input_and_parameters: not quantized by this q8-state rule

serialization.restart_splits: every token boundary, including empty prefix and the boundary immediately before QUERY

training_protocol.nonlearned_candidate: optimizer is NONE only if declared before implementation authorization
